Implementation of SumHer for estimating genetic covariance

Source: R/sumher.R
sumher_cov.Rd

Implementation of SumHer for estimating genetic covariance

Usage

sumher_cov(
  ss1,
  ss2,
  ldscores,
  h2_1 = NULL,
  h2_2 = NULL,
  sample_overlap = 0,
  fit_intercept = TRUE,
  tol = 1e-06,
  max_iter = 100,
  alpha = -0.25
)

Arguments

ss1

Summary statistics for trait 1: data.frame with columns Predictor, N, BETA, SE, Chisq and MAF (same SNPs and order as ldscores)

ss2

Summary statistics for trait 2, in the same format and SNP order as ss1

ldscores

Numeric vector of LD scores

h2_1

Heritability estimate for trait 1 (optional, will estimate if NULL)

h2_2

Heritability estimate for trait 2 (optional, will estimate if NULL)

sample_overlap

Proportion of sample overlap (default 0)

fit_intercept

Logical, fit intercept for overlap (default TRUE)

tol

Convergence tolerance (default 1e-6)

max_iter

Maximum iterations (default 100)

alpha

Selection parameter for the dependency of SNP heritability on MAF (default: -0.25)

Value

List with genetic correlation and covariance estimates
